findings: Concrete benefits and useful planning cases replace a thin feature list: selected-calendar overview, available hourly weather, forecast-hour draft, single-event sharing, Home Screen event layouts, weekly overlap checks.
iCloud device availability and selected calendars qualified; Microsoft explicitly Premium. Combined view does not promise provider merging or cross-account busy masking.
App Clip is an event preview requiring full app for adding; sign-in conditions retained. No anonymous sharing/guaranteed automatic delivery/RSVP claim.

Weather place/date/availability explicit; no every-event-address mapping,14-day guarantee or automatic booking. Wind/temperature map is supported by pinned build16 source; source-to-binary limitation remains in provenance records.
Widgets distinguish date/weather from medium/large event lists. Future timed eligibility and all-day exclusion retained; no Lock Screen widget, complete schedule or fixed refresh deadline claim.
Drag/resize restricted to editable appointments with calendar/time/repeat-scope checks; no mandatory occurrence prompt or universal provider acceptance promised.
Base/Advanced/Premium roles align with audited plan source; no paid provider permissions or privacy guarantee.
Current legal/subscription block preserved except removing redundant account from Apple ID account; privacy and EULA URLs unchanged.
